items.title: This REIT Is Today’s Best S&P 500 Stock
items.summary: Digital Realty Trust  stock took the  top spot on Friday after the data-center real estate investment trust scored an earnings beat and raised its full-year outlook.  After Thursday’s market close, the REIT reported adjusted core funds from operations of $2.13 a share, above the $1.87 from a year ago and Wall Street’s expectation of $1.98.  Total revenue increased 29% to $1.92 billion; the analyst consensus was $1.66 billion, according to FactSet.
